name: netconsole

module_load.rationale: The Linux safeguard persists the netconsole module load.

module_options.rationale: The Linux safeguard persists the operator-supplied netconsole target.

storage.rationale: Linux-only module configuration is verified by the handler's module seam.

description: Stream kernel oops/panic output to a remote log collector via the netconsole module

target.description: Kernel netconsole target in src-port@src-ip/dev,tgt-port@tgt-ip/tgt-mac format. There is no safe default because the collector is host-specific.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

linux.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.

macos.evidence: A mechanism exists but no implementation is wired for this host OS.

windows.evidence: A mechanism exists but no implementation is wired for this host OS.
